prompt.en: Which verses were the first to be revealed?
prompt.de: Welche Verse wurden als Erste offenbart?

explanation.en: According to ʿAʾishah's report in Sahih al-Bukhari, the first revelation was "Read in the name of your Lord…" (96:1–5).
explanation.de: Nach Aischas Bericht in Sahih al-Bukhari war die erste Offenbarung „Lies im Namen deines Herrn …“ (96:1–5).
explanation.bs: Prema Aišinoj predaji u Sahihu el-Buharija, prva Objava bila je „Čitaj, u ime Gospodara tvoga…“ (96:1–5).

prompt.en: After the first revelation, Khadijah told him that Allah would never disgrace him.
prompt.de: Nach der ersten Offenbarung sagte Chadidscha ihm, dass Allah ihn niemals zuschanden machen werde.
prompt.bs: Nakon prve Objave Hatidža mu je rekla da ga Allah nikada neće poniziti.

explanation.en: She pointed to his good deeds: keeping family ties, helping the weak, honouring guests and supporting people in hardship.
explanation.de: Sie verwies auf seine guten Taten: Verwandtschaftsbande pflegen, den Schwachen helfen, Gäste ehren und Menschen in Not beistehen.
explanation.bs: Ukazala je na njegova dobra djela: održavanje rodbinskih veza, pomaganje slabima, čašćenje gostiju i pomaganje ljudima u nevolji.

prompt.en: Put the events of the first revelation in order.
prompt.de: Bringe die Ereignisse der ersten Offenbarung in die richtige Reihenfolge.

text.en: Worship in the Cave of Hiraʾ

explanation.en: This is the order narrated by ʿAʾishah in Sahih al-Bukhari.
explanation.de: So berichtet es Aischa in Sahih al-Bukhari.
explanation.bs: Tim redom to prenosi Aiša u Sahihu el-Buharija.

prompt.en: Match each place or person with what happened there.
prompt.de: Ordne jeden Ort bzw. jede Person dem Geschehen zu.
prompt.bs: Poveži mjesto ili osobu s onim što se desilo.

right.en: Recognised the angel who came to Moses
right.de: Erkannte den Engel, der zu Moses kam
right.bs: Prepoznao meleka koji je dolazio Musau

explanation.en: All three are part of ʿAʾishah's narration of how the revelation began.
explanation.de: Alle drei sind Teil von Aischas Bericht über den Beginn der Offenbarung.
explanation.bs: Sve troje je dio Aišine predaje o početku Objave.

prompt.en: What came after the pause in revelation?
prompt.de: Was kam nach der Pause der Offenbarung?
prompt.bs: Šta je došlo nakon prekida Objave?

explanation.en: Jabir reported that after the pause the angel appeared again and "O you who covers himself, arise and warn" was revealed.
explanation.de: Dschabir berichtete, dass nach der Pause der Engel erneut erschien und „O du Zugedeckter, steh auf und warne“ offenbart wurde.
explanation.bs: Džabir je prenio da se nakon prekida melek ponovo pojavio i objavljeno je „O ti, pokriveni, ustani i opominji“.

prompt.en: Who connects the Cave of Hiraʾ and Waraqah ibn Nawfal in this story?
prompt.de: Wer verbindet in dieser Geschichte die Höhle Hira mit Waraqa ibn Naufal?
prompt.bs: Ko u ovoj priči povezuje pećinu Hira i Varaku ibn Nevfela?

explanation.en: Khadijah, his wife, was Waraqah's cousin and took him to Waraqah after he returned from the cave.
explanation.de: Chadidscha, seine Frau, war Waraqas Cousine und brachte ihn nach seiner Rückkehr aus der Höhle zu Waraqa.
explanation.bs: Hatidža, njegova supruga, bila je Varakina rođaka i odvela ga je Varaki nakon povratka iz pećine.
